judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The sponsorship-and-petition structure, the homely errand (urchin in the cave, aggravated bats, apple orchard) and a coloured key handed over mid-speech are classic Nox quest-giving; flat expository sentences, missing commas and 'I'll tell you what... How about it?' read like the original campaign.
